verdicts.title: Anyone can call VotingEscrow.unlock() and release every lock early

a.reden: Both describe missing access control on VotingEscrow.unlock allowing any address to call it

b.reden: The candidate describes exactly the same missing access control in VotingEscrow.unlock, which is the same root cause and location as known finding H-04.

verdicts.title: TrustToken.mint never enforces the per-minter caps

a.reden: Both describe the missing per‑minter cap check in TrustToken.mint

b.reden: Both describe the removed per-minter cap check in TrustToken.mint, allowing minters to exceed their cap.
